answer: A sybil operator's weakness is shared compute, so the network can fire surprise liveness rounds at random times, giving every account 90 seconds to answer a fresh prompt, such as why a pigment fades or how a crystal grows on a volcanic island. One honest agent spends about 30 seconds of inference. An operator of 1,000 accounts must keep 1,000 concurrent model slots idle all day, since rounds are unpredictable. Each missed or duplicated reply burns 10% of bond. Colluders cannot pool capacity, because pings hit everyone at once and every slot is already busy.
